snippet.title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales | TGS Trailer
snippet.description:
A brand-new action RPG from the creators of OCTOPATH TRAVELER and BRAVELY DEFAULT - The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales combines stunning HD-2D visuals and exciting action-adventure gameplay for the first time!

The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales is coming to Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC in 2026! The debut demo is available now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-adventures-of-elliot-the-millennium-tales-debut-demo-switch-2/
